item.title: iOS 27.3 Expands StandBy to iPhone 11+ – What It Means
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27.3 rolls out expanded StandBy mode to iPhone 11 and newer, adding customizable clocks, photos, calendar, weather and more for convenience.

item.title: iOS 27.3 Beta Brings iPhone Duo StandBy to All iPhones
item.description: Apple's iOS 27.3 beta 1 adds new clock faces, shared-album support, and lets iPhone 11-plus users create StandBy faces, expanding Duo's smart-display.
